Title: DeepDL drug-likeness scoring
Description: Returns a drug-likeness score between 0 and 100 derived from the same unsupervised language-model approach, which learns from approved drugs without requiring examples of what a non-drug looks like. Features are extracted directly from molecular structure rather than from a fixed rule set, avoiding the sharp cut-offs of Lipinski-style filters. Because training reflects historical development choices, the score rewards familiar medicinal chemistry and may penalise legitimately novel scaffolds.
Interpretation: Drug-likeness score from 0 to 100, higher values indicating greater resemblance to approved drugs.
